Every logo. Every removal attempt.

42 tested and individually reviewed · 10 accepted · 32 originals preserved. Raw attempts include known defects and are shown for inspection, not recommended use. Click any image to inspect its actual pixels at 4×. The reference is the known-alpha source before flattening, where available.

Two bugs fixed: validation ran before edge correction, and erased 1–2 pixel details could evade the safeguard. Apple, Figma and the wide wordmark now pass. This small diagnostic set has informed the fixes; it is not a general success-rate estimate.

Raw has pale outlines around thin stems and detached i dots on black. Refinement removes halo, preserving legibility and all dots; returned output looks consistent with reference at native and 4x.

Final status: applied · Visual verdict: pass
